brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：能对上的解到底；对不上的，说「失败」。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that solves what can be fitted to the end, and says “failed” of what cannot.

hint.zh: 先拆开，再找两边结构不同的等式。
hint.en: Split first, then look for an equation whose sides differ in shape.

t.zh: 规则不一定对得上目标。拼接的结论是「并且」，目标是「或者」时，?A、?B 怎样填都对不上。新元件「冲突」：找到两边都不是 ?-字母、结构却不同的等式，宣布失败。用规则时，失败说明该换一条规则。
t.en: A rule need not fit a goal. Join concludes an “and”; against an “or”, nothing put in for ?A and ?B makes them fit. A new part, “Conflict”, finds an equation with no ?-letter on either side and sides of different shapes, and declares failure. When using rules, failure means trying another rule.
